content: आरोपणम् .²1 placing or fixing in or upon, putting; आर्द्राक्षतारोपणमन्वभूताम् <ls>R. 7. 28</ls>; <ls>Ku. 7. 88</ls>; (<ab>fig.</ab>) establishing, installing; अधिकारारोपणम् <ls>Mu. 3</ls>. .²2 Causing to mount or ascend, raising (to heaven). .²3 Planting. .²4 The stringing of a bow. .²5 Trusting, delivering.
